items.definition:
a toxic alkaloid found in tobacco
Nicotine is the addictive substance in cigarettes.

energy and high spirits
The coach gave a pep talk to motivate the team.

the unauthorized use or reproduction of another's work
Software piracy is a serious problem for many companies.

a subdivision of a company of soldiers
The platoon marched through the dense jungle.

an extremely enthusiastic review or party
The new restaurant received rave reviews from critics.

suffering or death caused by lack of food
Millions of people around the world face starvation.

the part of a tire that touches the ground
The car's tires had very little tread left.

an agreement between enemies or opponents to stop fighting or arguing for a certain time
The two warring factions agreed to a temporary truce.

the state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy
Exercise is crucial for your overall wellbeing.

a place full of wonderful things or experiences
The theme park was a true wonderland for children.

the division of an area into zones, especially to restrict the number and types of buildings and their uses
The city council approved new zoning regulations for the downtown area.

the quality of being able to be reached or entered; the quality of being easy to understand or use
The new building was designed with full accessibility for people with disabilities.

A strong alcoholic spirit distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice.
He enjoyed a glass of brandy after dinner.

The extreme edge of land before a steep slope or a body of water; a point at which something is about to happen.
The country was on the brink of war.

A system of winds rotating inwards to an area of low atmospheric pressure, with an anticlockwise or clockwise circulation.
The cyclone caused widespread damage to the coastal areas.

An instance of turning something aside from its course; an activity that diverts the mind from tedious or serious concerns; a recreation or pastime.
The road closure caused a major diversion.

A short extract from a film, broadcast, or piece of music or writing.
She read an excerpt from the new novel.

The fans of a particular person, team, series, etc., regarded collectively as a community or subculture.
The show has a very dedicated fandom.

An enemy or opponent.
He faced his old foe in the final match.

An escape or quick departure; a short holiday or vacation.
The thieves made a quick getaway in a stolen car.

The quality of fascinating or alluring charm or beauty.
Hollywood is often associated with glamour and fame.

intervention in a dispute in order to resolve it
They opted for mediation instead of going to court.

a person reaching young adulthood in the early 21st century
Many millennials are now entering the housing market.

a person who has broken the law, especially one who remains at large or is a fugitive
The sheriff was determined to catch the notorious outlaw.

a public entertainment consisting of a procession of people in elaborate costumes, or a competition for beauty
The annual beauty pageant attracts many contestants.

an organism that lives in or on an organism of another species (its host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the other's expense
Some insects are known to be parasites of plants.

firm or obstinate continuance in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition
Her persistence paid off, and she finally achieved her goal.

a group of words taken from a text or speech and repeated by someone other than the original author or speaker
She ended her speech with a famous quotation.

a gunfight
The police were involved in a shootout with the bank robbers.

the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other
The human face often exhibits a degree of symmetry.

a medical imaging technique
The doctor performed an ultrasound to check the baby's development.

one's family or ethnic descent
She traced her ancestry back to the 17th century.

a building added to a larger one
The library built a new annex to house its growing collection.

a water pipe used for smoking
He kept a bong hidden in his closet.

a payment made to a person to persuade them to act dishonestly
The politician was accused of taking a bribe.

behavior that is polite, moral, and respectable
He always treated everyone with decency and respect.

a person or thing that destroys, especially a fast warship
The navy deployed a destroyer to the area.

a secure grip or position
Be careful not to lose your footing on the icy path.

a person who handles or manages something or someone
The dog handler trained the police dog.

a person who expresses strong dislike or criticism
Don't listen to the haters, just keep doing your best.

widespread destruction or disorder
The storm wreaked havoc on the coastal towns.

a leader in a mosque
The imam led the prayers at the mosque.

a device or tissue placed in the body
She received a dental implant to replace her missing tooth.

a large cash prize
He won the jackpot in the lottery.

a railway engine
The old steam locomotive pulled the carriages.

a strong desire or yearning
She felt a deep longing for her homeland.

a word or phrase repeated often
Her daily mantra was "I can do this."

the action of animals breeding
The mating season for deer is in autumn.

a flat-topped hill or mountain
The landscape was dominated by a large mesa.

nugget
She found a gold nugget in the stream.

nuisance
The loud music was a real nuisance.

obedience
The dog showed great obedience to its owner.

overload
The system experienced an information overload.

pivot
The door swung on its pivot.

primer
Apply a coat of primer before painting.

Sabbath
They observe the Sabbath every week.

scouting
The team is doing some scouting for new talent.

poisonous substance
The snake venom contained a powerful toxin.

a shady garden alcove
They sat in the cool arbor on a hot day.

clothes, especially formal ones
Formal attire is required for the event.

a rod connecting two wheels
The car's axle broke, leaving it stranded.

a sudden emergence or escape
The band had a breakout hit with their new song.

a type of crane
The oil rig had a tall derrick.

state of expecting
Life expectancy has increased over the years.
